solution: For $f(x)=\begin{cases} x+1, & x<0 \\ x^2, & x\ge 0 \end{cases}$ the value is $f(0)=0$.

questions.question: For $A=\begin{pmatrix} \cos\theta & -\sin\theta \\ \sin\theta & \cos\theta \end{pmatrix}$ which of the following is/are true?
questions.key_idea: $A$ is the rotation matrix, so $A^n$ rotates by $n\theta$.

questions.question: Find $\begin{vmatrix} x & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & x & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & x \end{vmatrix}$ at $x=3$.
questions.key_idea: Add all columns to $C_1$ and factor out $x+2$.

alternate_solutions.idea: The matrix is $(x-1)I+J$ where $J$ is the all-ones matrix.
solution: So the eigenvalues of $(x-1)I+J$ are $x+2,\ x-1,\ x-1$ and the determinant is $(x+2)(x-1)^2=20$.

useful_results: $\begin{vmatrix} a & b & b \\ b & a & b \\ b & b & a \end{vmatrix}=(a+2b)(a-b)^2$.
For the $n\times n$ version the determinant is $(a+(n-1)b)(a-b)^{n-1}$.
